rows: Interpret 3/4 × 20: start with 20 as one quantity and select 3/4 of it.
Convert to improper fractions when needed: 3/4 × 20/1.
Multiply the selected parts: (3 × 20)/(4 × 1) = 60/4; simplify to 15.
scenes.memo: 3/4 × 20 = 15. Check the whole by dividing 15 by 3/4 to recover 20.
scenes.misconception: Do not multiply only one numerator; preserve each whole and convert mixed numbers before multiplying.
